scope: All §7 sequencing/journal/snapshot/recovery/fault bullets and intro/trailing clauses; §11 seven concurrency/recovery/UI bullets; §13 ACK/restart-dedup criterion. Separate six-hour/OS-power scope guards.
method: Read-only source/test-body/raw-log/saved-DOM inspection plus offline byte/hash calculations. No build/test/load/service/process control. Only new audit.md/json written.

status_definitions.proven: Finite inspected local implementation and executed evidence supports exact stated scope, not universal or OS/power proof.
status_definitions.incomplete: Some required/followup direct evidence absent or pending.
status_definitions.unverified: No direct validation of separately named scope.

findings.detail: Unit gap and actual reconnect proofs exist; deliberate browser event-gap→refresh→render convergence not found. No production defect established.
findings.action: Keep combined row incomplete unless separate direct browser gap evidence is provided.

provenance_limits: Storage/core raw tests have commands/exit/assertions but no historical launched test executable SHA. Current source or target hashes cannot replace missing historical executable identity.
Common API suite lacks per-launch executable SHA. Its checkpoint case retained copied executable, now hashed, but launch-time digest absent.
Aged recovery retained validator binary with contemporaneous SHA manifest; all27 artifacts checked. Current core/model hashes equal historical source manifest.
Full recovery claims use full Core images; HTTP MarketSnapshot truncates terminal orders/trades.
Earlier aged demo recovery cannot be relabeled as pending six-hour cumulative recovery.
Process kill and software sync seam do not validate real OS/power/storage-controller failure; Windows directory sync limitation persists.

S.scope: Release raw output7 unit+13 integration pass0fail. Test bodies cover actual bytes/CRC/failclosed/full Core/dedup. Historical launched test executable SHA not captured.

K.scope: Actual child killed during trading:25 captured ACKs,27 recovered records, snapshot21+replay6; exact-prefix full Core reference and retries asserted. Process only.

P.scope: Real child/process termination at test-only pauses inside actual snapshot publication.39/6200 partial temp and6200-byte synced unpublished temp;5 ACKs each; snapshot1+4 replay; full Core and duplicate assertions.

A.scope: Raw10pass0fail actual engines.12 concurrent clients,12 fill/cancel races, clean restart, dropped durable response+kill, WS reconnect, stalled-body shutdown, checkpoint-path503/shutdown1 then recovery. No common per-launch binary SHA; checkpoint copy retained.

G.scope: Earlier real demo offline copy with exclusive writer.lock. Both full Core images+invariants,22233commands/cache,19305orders,12260trades. All27 retained hashes directly verified. Not pending six-hour dataset.

C.scope: Release19core+1oracle pass.4seeds×1000commands; independent scan/sort3000. Current core/model hashes match historical source manifest. Historical unit executable SHA unavailable.

U.scope: Raw7/7units:10→14 gap decision=resync. Source refresh branch inspected, not browser gap end-to-end execution.

B.scope: Actual saved browser DOM: EVENT2971→3026, confirmedorder1651/command1908 and assets998965P/1033h retained after engine restart. No deliberately omitted WS frame evidence.

F.scope: Actual browser unknown ACK outcome, reload, lookup and same-key retry raw evidence. HTTP ACK-loss fixture connects WS directly; not gap injection.

rows.requirement: 시퀀스 부여, 저널 기록, 내구성 확보, 상태 반영, 응답·이벤트 공개의 순서와 장애 시 의미를 ADR로 고정한다. 구체적인 순서는 선택한 설계에 따르되 보장 사항과 모순되면 안 된다.
rows.proof: write_all → sync_all → deterministic apply → durable result/event. Single writer and ADR agree.
rows.limit: Finite failure seams/process tests; not every instruction-level interleaving.

rows.requirement: 단조 증가하는 엔진 명령 순번.
rows.proof: Every newly admitted command advances sequence once. Duplicates/conflicts preserve original sequence; non-admission does not advance. Journal sequence is distinct.
rows.limit: 12 concurrent admitted commands have unique seq; restart/retry no state-seq increase.

rows.requirement: 버전·레코드 경계·길이·무결성 검사를 포함한 저널.
rows.proof: 32-byte framing has version/magic/flags/seq/length/header CRC/payload CRC. Tests corrupt header length, middle payload, complete final CRC and cut every incomplete byte boundary.
rows.limit: CRC detects accidental corruption, not adversarial authenticity.

rows.requirement: 재시작 이후에도 보장 기간 안에서 유지되는 요청 중복 방지.
rows.proof: Full Core includes account/request action+result cache. Dataset lifetime retention, no automatic expiry/eviction. Same-action and conflicting reuse across restart tested; aged 22233-entry cache byte-equal.
rows.limit: Capacity exhaustion does not evict prior keys. Dataset reset/deletion outside guarantee.

rows.requirement: 기본 모드에서 성공 ACK한 거래의 복구 보장.
rows.proof: Observed durable ACKs survive normal/forced restart and snapshot interruption. Recovered committed prefix equals complete deterministic Core.
rows.limit: Conditional on OS/storage honoring sync; real OS/power failure unverified.

rows.requirement: 저널 write·flush·OS 동기화와 ACK의 관계 명시.
rows.proof: Unbuffered File::write_all is not durability; sync_all precedes apply and ACK. ADR distinguishes OS write, sync and Unix directory sync.
rows.limit: Windows directory metadata power-loss guarantee explicitly limited.

rows.requirement: batching 사용 시 지연·처리량·내구성 영향 명시.
rows.proof: Conditional batching requirement not active. One record sync per process call; group commit deferred; simpler durability boundary versus throughput tradeoff documented.
rows.limit: No batching benchmark or batching fault-proof claim.

rows.requirement: 내구성 확보에 실패한 요청에 성공 ACK를 반환하지 않는 오류 처리.
rows.proof: Partial-write, read-only-handle actual write syscall failure, injected sync error and after-sync interruption return errors without success ACK/live apply. API checkpoint failure durable:false/503; shutdown exit1.
rows.limit: Sync failure is software seam, not actual device-sync error.

rows.requirement: 저널 I/O 실패 시 후속 주문 접수·처리 정책과 복구 절차.
rows.proof: Journal write/sync error fails closed; further process/checkpoint reject without extending suffix. Restart validates/repairs safe tail and syncs before ready. Failed absent lookup is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
rows.limit: Failed absent live HTTP lookup branch inspected statically; storage failure boundaries directly tested.

rows.requirement: 프로세스 종료, OS 장애, 전원 장애에 대한 보장 범위 구분.
rows.proof: ADR and raw crash reports explicitly distinguish process/offline recovery from OS/power proof.
rows.limit: Actual OS/power tests remain unverified.

rows.requirement: 미응답 요청의 처리 여부 조회와 안전한 재시도.
rows.proof: Unknown after sync seam resolved after restart lookup; actual dropped durable HTTP response then kill/retry has one effect. Browser unknown/reload/lookup/retry preserved.
rows.limit: Transient IO errors never establish authoritative rejection.

rows.requirement: 정확한 엔진 순번에 대응하는 일관된 상태를 저장한다.
rows.proof: Writer checkpoints between commands: full Core, command/event seq, journal seq/offset/prefix CRC. Snapshot1+tail matches child-before state.
rows.limit: No concurrent mutation of borrowed Core during save.

rows.requirement: 호가장, 잔고·예약, 주문 상태, ID·순번, 중복 방지 상태를 포함한다.
rows.proof: Full Core includes books/accounts/reserves/all orders/trades/IDs/sequences/cache. 16.5MB full images independently equal.
rows.limit: Public HTTP bounded history is not used as full recovery proof.

rows.requirement: 불완전한 스냅샷이 정상 스냅샷으로 선택되지 않도록 저장·게시 절차를 구현한다.
rows.proof: Unpublished create_new temp → write → sync → immutable rename. Real kill partial/synced-unpublished keeps prior snapshot selected. Invalid latest published snapshot fallback tested.
rows.limit: Actual OS/power rename persistence unverified.

rows.requirement: 유효한 스냅샷과 이후 저널로 복구한다.
rows.proof: Full journal validation plus snapshot prefix match; replay suffix. Actual kill snapshot21+6; snapshot-save kill snapshot1+4. Image ahead of journal refuses startup.
rows.limit: Validated prefix, not blind trust in checkpoint filename.

rows.requirement: 복구 중 신규 주문 접수를 제어하고 복구 완료 상태를 노출한다.
rows.proof: Store recovery/invariants complete before listener bind. Raw logs recovering → recovery_complete → ready; health/state reports ready.
rows.limit: No deliberate recovery hold plus TCP probe test; static listener order enforces admission exclusion.

rows.requirement: 정상 종료 후 재시작.
rows.proof: Checkpoint, graceful exit0 without kill/fallback, restart: same public state, original durable lookup and duplicate. Earlier offline demo compared full Core.
rows.limit: Current six-hour dataset recovery pending.

rows.requirement: 거래 중 프로세스 강제 종료 후 재시작.
rows.proof: Actual child.kill during trading and API SIGKILL after response drop; captured ACKs recover and reference replays exact journal prefix.
rows.limit: Process only, not kernel/power/controller loss.

rows.requirement: 스냅샷 저장 중 중단.
rows.proof: Actual child killed inside real publication helper at partial write and synced-before-publish. 5 ACKs, old snapshot/temp preserved, child-before/reference equality plus retry/re-checkpoint.
rows.limit: Controlled cfg(test) pause, not arbitrary instruction timing.

rows.requirement: 저널 마지막 레코드의 부분 기록과 저널 중간 손상.
rows.proof: Every incomplete prefix of one frame recovers prior ACK state and exact suffix. Torn header/payload preserved; middle/complete final/header CRC corruption fails with journal bytes unchanged.
rows.limit: Finite frame fixture.

rows.requirement: ACK 전후 장애, 응답 유실 후 재시도, 저널 쓰기 실패.
rows.proof: Before-ACK after-sync failure seam, after-ACK actual kill, actual network-response drop, actual read-only-handle write failure, lookup/retry.
rows.limit: Software sync-error seam does not exercise failing hardware.

rows.requirement: 원본 실행과 같은 확정 입력 범위를 재생한 결과의 주문·잔고·호가장 비교.
rows.proof: Reference executes exactly recovered journal count, not just observed ACK count. Child-before and aged full Core compare all orders/accounts/books/cache.
rows.limit: Aged proof is earlier22233-command dataset.

rows.requirement: 부분 기록과 중간 손상의 정책을 구분한다.
rows.proof: Structurally incomplete final EOF only: preserve then shorten. Complete invalid framing/checksum/seq and middle corruption fatal.
rows.limit: No silent skip.

rows.requirement: 복구할 수 없는 손상을 조용히 무시하거나 증거를 삭제하지 않는다.
rows.proof: Fatal corrupt journals byte-identical; recoverable suffix saved/synced before set_len. Bad snapshots/unpublished temporary files retained; no automatic pruning.
rows.limit: Preservation assertions inspect bytes, not only summary status.

rows.requirement: 성공 ACK한 요청의 복구와 미응답 요청의 상태 확인을 각각 검증한다.
rows.proof: Known durable ACK set and unknown outcome tested separately. Unknown may commit or be absent; lookup and same-key retry reconcile without new effect.
rows.limit: Unknown is not synonymous with rejected.

rows.requirement: 프로세스 강제 종료 테스트만으로 OS·전원 장애까지 검증했다고 보고하지 않는다.
rows.proof: Inspected crash reports and ADR explicitly deny OS/power validation from process kill.
rows.limit: Scope guard below remains unverified.

rows.requirement: 최소 12개 동시 클라이언트의 주문·취소.
rows.proof: Promise.all12 clients place/cancel;12 same-key duplicates; unique seq/restored balances. Additional12 fill/cancel races derive result from durable sequence, check reserves/settlement and replay after restart.
rows.limit: Finite actual HTTP schedules; no preferred timing winner asserted.

rows.requirement: 고정 seed 무작위 명령과 불변조건 검사.
rows.proof: Four fixed seeds×1000 mixed commands, per-command invariants/result replay, periodic dedup/serde and final full Core equality.
rows.limit: Finite sample, not exhaustive state proof.

rows.requirement: 가능한 경우 단순 참조 모델과 결과 대조.
rows.proof: Independent scan/sort oracle3000 seeded commands: result codes/fills/books/reserves/accounts, >100 successful trades/cancels asserted.
rows.limit: Oracle tests matching domain, not independent storage implementation.

rows.requirement: 장애 주입 후 같은 확정 입력 범위의 정상 결과와 복구 결과 비교.
rows.proof: Faulted state compared to normal exact recovered input-prefix reference and child-before full Core; aged snapshot/full-journal equality.
rows.limit: Full state proof does not rely on bounded public snapshot.

rows.requirement: 성공 ACK 보장, 미응답 요청 확인, 재시도 중복 방지.
rows.proof: Distinct known ACK and unknown-response restart lookup/retry cases preserve original order/trade/state without second effect.
rows.limit: Local process/filesystem scope.

rows.requirement: UI 이벤트 누락, 재연결, 상태 재동기화.
rows.proof: Passing10→14 gap-decision unit; source invokes HTTP refresh. Actual browser restart and API WS reconnect convergence evidenced.
rows.limit: No inspected artifact deliberately drops a browser WS event then observes gap detection→HTTP refresh→render convergence. ACK-loss fixture keeps WS direct. No production defect established.

rows.requirement: 채택한 동시성 구조에 적합한 검증 도구 적용.
rows.proof: Single-writer bounded queue validated via actual parallel clients/sequence oracle, FS2 exclusive dataset lock test, deterministic replay/invariants and subprocess faults.
rows.limit: Not exhaustive async model checking; no custom lock-free/unsafe matching proof claimed.

rows.requirement: 성공 ACK 보장과 재시작 후 중복 방지 검증.
rows.proof: Successful ACK recovery and restart dedup across normal, forced and save-interruption paths; full-state comparisons.
rows.limit: Process guarantee only; latest six-hour cumulative recovery remains separate.

rows.requirement: 최근 6시간 관찰 종료 후 해당 누적 데이터의 full Core 복구
rows.proof: Earlier offline22233-command dataset recovery proven.
rows.limit: Parent reports current six-hour observation/final recovery pending. No live copy/stop/recovery performed by audit.

rows.requirement: 실제 OS·전원 장애 복구 실증
rows.proof: File sync boundary and conditional guarantees documented.
rows.limit: No actual OS crash/power-cut evidence. Separate scope boundary, not an assertion that §7 demanded a destructive power test.
